name: SEO S.A.M – Search Analysis & Marketing
author: seosamapp

sections.description:
SEO S.A.M Lite gives WordPress site owners a simple free SEO scan and action plan.

SAM stands for Search Analysis & Marketing. The Lite plugin checks common on-site SEO issues and explains what needs attention in plain English.

What SAM Lite includes

  • A free local SEO scan.
  • A simple score.
  • A list of common page-level SEO issues.
  • Plain-English explanations.
  • A practical action plan.
  • Links to learn about SEO S.A.M Pro.

What SAM Pro adds

SEO S.A.M Pro is a separate paid plugin available from https://seo-sam.mallorcatech.es/.

Pro is the worker version of SAM. It adds automatic safe fixes, job tracking, Search Console intelligence, PDF reports, competitor gaps, content growth tools, data connectors, and deeper SEO workflows.

SEO S.A.M Pro is designed to feel different from a normal SEO plugin. Instead of only showing settings and warnings, SAM uses its own built-in SEO logic, business memory, issue evidence, and safe-fix rules to decide what should happen next. The core system does not require customers to buy a separate AI subscription.

The WordPress.org plugin is the free Lite edition. The paid Pro edition is distributed separately from the SEO S.A.M website.

Privacy

SAM Lite scans published site content locally in WordPress and stores the latest scan result in the WordPress database.

SAM Lite does not automatically send scan data to any third-party service.

The plugin includes links to the SEO S.A.M website. Those links only load if you click them.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/seo-s-a-m-search-analysis-marketing directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Open SEO S.A.M in the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Run the free SEO scan.
  5. Review the score and action plan.
sections.faq:
Does the free plugin fix SEO issues automatically?

No. SAM Lite is the free diagnostic version. It scans the site and explains what needs attention. Automatic fixing is part of the separate SAM Pro plugin.

Does SAM Lite send my site data to an external service?

No. SAM Lite performs its scan locally inside WordPress. It does not send scan data to SEO S.A.M servers.

Does SAM Lite use Google Search Console?

No. Search Console connection is a Pro feature and is not included in this free plugin.

Can I upgrade to Pro?

Yes. You can learn about SAM Pro at https://seo-sam.mallorcatech.es/.

  • Added uninstall cleanup so deleting the plugin removes its saved scan and chat data from the database.
  • Improved the word count used by the thin-content check so accented text and languages written without spaces are counted correctly.

1.96.6

  • Changed Lite chat suggestion pills so they fill the message box first instead of instantly submitting.
  • Added a compact “Ask SAM about this issue” action to each issue card.
  • Tightened Lite issue card spacing so the free scan feels cleaner and less cluttered.

1.96.5

  • Fixed Lite quick reply buttons so they submit the selected SAM prompt instead of the empty text box.

1.96.4

  • Made Lite issue cards cleaner by showing the diagnosis first and moving Pro explanations behind a reveal button.
  • Improved SAM Lite quick replies so score, problems, and Pro previews give clearer separate answers.
  • Reduced visible scan clutter by showing the first six issue cards and summarising the remaining count.

1.96.3

  • Added a Lite demo button so users can ask SAM how Pro would fix a specific scan issue.
  • Improved the free scan experience with clearer Pro workflow explanations inside the SAM chat.

1.96.2

  • Added the real SEO S.A.M assistant image to the Lite chat interface.

1.96.1

  • Improved the Lite scan UI with a friendlier SAM chat-style introduction.
  • Added a Top 3 priority plan after each scan.
  • Added clearer “What Pro would do” previews for scan issues.
  • Polished the free plugin layout so Lite feels more premium and easier to understand.

1.96.0

  • Initial SAM Lite release.
  • Added free SEO scan.
  • Added plain-English score and action plan.
  • Added clear upgrade path to the separate SAM Pro plugin.
